name: cafeteria
description: Sistema de ventas de una cafetería: API NestJS y frontend Next.js en un solo repo.

scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w @cafeteria/shared && npm run prisma:generate -w @cafeteria/api
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @cafeteria/api -w @cafeteria/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @cafeteria/api && npm run test:e2e -w @cafeteria/api && npm run test -w @cafeteria/web
scripts.lint: npm run build:shared && npm run lint -w @cafeteria/api -w @cafeteria/web
